results.content: # 7th International Conference on Infection Prevention and Control (CPD Accredited). Coalesce Research Group takes the immense Pleasure to invite all the Speakers, Delegates, Researchers, Students and Industrialists to join our **“7th International Conference on Infection Prevention and Control”**. > 7th International Conference on Infection Prevention and Control. I am truly honored to be speaking at this year’s Infection Prevention and Control Conference, and I would personally love to invite you to join us. The 5**th** **International Conference on Infection Prevention and Control**was held on **November 11-12, 2024** at **Renaissance London Heathrow Hotel, London, UK**with the **Theme: "Infectious Diseases Prevention, Control and Cure"** and has witnessed an amalgamation of outstanding speakers who enlightened the attendees with their knowledge related to the field of Infectious Diseases Prevention and Control. * **Bushra Chaudhry**, University Hospitals Dorset NHS Foundation Trust, UK. * **Muhammad Ayhan Amir**, University Hospitals Dorset NHS Foundation Trust, UK. * **Hadia Zaheer Lone**, University Hospitals Dorset NHS Foundation Trust, UK.
